UNINSTALLED.description: No manifest-owned System Mode installation is present.

PREFLIGHTED.description: Doctor passed and external recovery evidence was verified.

STAGED.description: Payload, policy, init, manifest, and journal candidates were staged and hashed.

COMMITTED.description: All persistent mutations were committed; a boot verification is required.

BOOT_VERIFIED.description: The committed installation passed its declared cold-boot verification.

ROLLBACK_REQUIRED.description: A failure occurred after staging or commit and rollback must complete before any retry.

ROLLING_BACK.description: Manifest-owned paths are being restored in reverse journal order.

FAILED.description: Automatic rollback could not prove a safe terminal state; external restore is required.
